purchase_objections: An accepted change list does not prove the entire pack now ties out; I still need to inspect the corrected deck.
Can it preserve my actual templates and handle references beyond this curated example?
Does reviewing its changes reduce my checking burden, or add another queue to audit?
I already use Office tools and model-to-slide links; I need evidence that this handles cross-file revisions more reliably.
My CFO and compliance team would still need deployment, data-handling and commercial details before approving a purchase.

buy_decision: TRY_FIRST — a successful pilot on my own recurring pack, preserving its formatting and correctly updating every dependent reference, would flip me to BUY.
